title: Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreements: A Geometric Perspective

summary.problem: Active learning framework that addresses BALD's sensitivity to uninformative priors via initial core-set acquisitions and prevents redundant information via representativeness-constrained uncertainty ranking.

questions.prompt: 'Two-stage GBALD Algorithm' builds directly on which of these?
options: Generalization Error Bounds for Ellipsoid Search
questions.explain: In the paper map, it depends on: Two-Stage GBALD Active Learning Framework, Ellipsoid Geodesic Core-set Construction, Geometric Representativeness Ranking.

questions.prompt: Which equation does this describe? "Objective function maximizing the expected reduction in model parameter entropy (mutual information between predictions and parameters)."
options: Probability Mass of Zero Error on Ellipsoid
questions.explain: That is Standard BALD Acquisition Objective (Section 3.1).

questions.prompt: Which equation does this describe? "Decomposition of expected complete data log posterior into initial log posterior and sum over individual data log-likelihood and entropy terms."
options: Generalization Error Bounds for Ellipsoid Search
Generalization Error Bounds for Spherical Search
questions.explain: That is Complete Data Log Posterior Decomposition (Section 3.2).

questions.prompt: Where in the paper is 'Two-stage GBALD Algorithm' described?
questions.explain: The paper map points to Section 5 / Algorithm 1.

questions.prompt: What delivery label did this run get?
questions.explain: The label is the first line of REPORT.md.

questions.prompt: In R2C, what does the label 'verified' mean?
options: The code runs and passed a behavioral check that a trivial baseline fails
Every test passed on a GPU at full scale
The paper's headline numbers were reproduced
The paper's authors reviewed the code
questions.explain: Verified never means the paper's full-scale numbers were reproduced.
